# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 5 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan's Story — Why He Refused to Worship Adam

---

**5:1** Adam said to the devil: 'Why do you fight against us? What have we done to you? Why do you pursue us with deceit and envy?'

**5:2** The devil answered with a great sigh: 'Adam, all my enmity, envy, and sorrow are because of you. It is because of you that I was cast out of heaven and expelled from the company of the angels.'

**5:3** Adam said to him: 'What have I done to you? How am I to blame? You have not been harmed by me at all.'

**5:4** The devil replied: 'When you were created, I was cast out. When God breathed into you the breath of life and your face and likeness were made in the image of God, Michael brought you and made you worship before God in the sight of all the angels. And God said: "Worship Adam." And I worshiped you.'

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
